tokens.name: nx-ink
tokens.usage: All text, all borders, all offset shadows; metrics, CTA and footer section background. Body text on nx-paper and nx-paper-dim.

tokens.name: nx-ink-soft
tokens.usage: Section intro and lead paragraph text on nx-paper and nx-paper-dim.

tokens.name: nx-paper
tokens.usage: Card backgrounds and white content sections. Headline and pill text on nx-blue and nx-ink.

tokens.name: nx-paper-dim
tokens.usage: Alternate content sections (is-dim), light gray in the section rhythm.

tokens.name: nx-blue
tokens.usage: Hero, CTA and feature section backgrounds only, always with the 64px grid. Never a text color. White headline text on it is 4.4:1: fine at headline sizes, not for body text.

tokens.name: nx-mint
tokens.usage: Primary CTA buttons (with nx-ink text) and success states. Program 2 accent.

tokens.name: nx-mint-pale
tokens.usage: Pale fill behind Program 2 content, such as price boxes.

tokens.name: nx-cyan
tokens.usage: Metric values on nx-ink; link underlines in articles; default page accent.

tokens.name: nx-cyan-pale
tokens.usage: Pale fill for the default cyan accent.

tokens.name: nx-pink
tokens.usage: Nav CTA, eyebrow pills, accents, article reading progress bar and link hover. Program 5 accent. White text on it is about 2.9:1, under 4.5:1 for small text: kept as the source has it.

tokens.name: nx-yellow
tokens.usage: Program 4 accent and energy accents; never a primary surface. Use nx-ink text on it.

tokens.name: nx-grid-line
tokens.usage: Declared grid line color (index, about, article). The live .nx-grid-bg draws its lines at rgba(255,255,255,.07) instead.

tokens.name: p1
tokens.usage: Program 1 accent: Architecture Evolution. Set as --acc on body, never hardcoded.

styles.name: hero
styles.sample: Your CRM should tell you where the money is.
styles.usage: Hero headline, fluid clamp(34px, 4.8vw, 58px). White on nx-blue grid.

styles.name: section-h2
styles.usage: Section headline, fluid clamp(28px, 3.6vw, 42px), centered in a section head.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrow label, lives inside a colored pill.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: A CRM your team trusts. Consistent data. A pipeline with clear rules.

styles.name: section-intro
styles.usage: Section head intro copy, nx-ink-soft, max three lines.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Body text, 16 to 18px with line height 1.5 to 1.65.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Prices, codes and tech labels only, 12 to 15px. Never headlines.

tokens.name: nx-grid-cell
tokens.usage: Cell size of the blue grid background.

tokens.name: nx-grid-width
tokens.usage: Line width of the blue grid background.

tokens.name: nx-drop-sm
tokens.usage: Resting state of cards, pills and buttons.

tokens.name: nx-drop-md
tokens.usage: Tier cards and panels; hover state of every card and button.
